words.defn_en: unintentionally or by accident:

sentences.en: The new worker caused a ruckus when he ______ deleted an important file.
sentences.zh: 這位新員工不小心刪除了一份重要檔案,因而引起一陣騷動。

sentences.en: She ______ revealed the surprise party while talking on the phone.
sentences.zh: 她在講電話時無意間洩漏了驚喜派對的消息。

words.defn_en: unable to be taken away or transferred:
words.defn_zh: 不可剝奪的;不可轉讓的
words.root_note: in- (not) + alienare (to make foreign), from Latin

sentences.en: The declaration lists life and liberty as ______ rights.
sentences.zh: 這份宣言將生命與自由列為不可剝奪的權利。

sentences.en: Freedom of speech is considered an ______ right in many nations.
sentences.zh: 言論自由在許多國家被視為不可剝奪的權利。

words.defn_en: lifeless:

sentences.en: A rock is an ______ object, unlike a plant or an animal.
sentences.zh: 石頭是無生命的物體,不像植物或動物。

sentences.en: The children imagined the ______ toys coming to life at night.
sentences.zh: 孩子們幻想這些沒有生命的玩具在夜裡活了過來。

words.defn_en: not relevant or appropriate:

sentences.en: The old rule was deemed ______ to the new situation.
sentences.zh: 這條舊規則被認為不適用於這個新情況。

sentences.en: Most of the advice proved ______ to her unique circumstances.
sentences.zh: 大多數建議對她獨特的處境都不適用。

words.defn_en: not suitable or proper in the circumstances:
words.root_note: in- (not) + appropriare (to make one's own), from Latin

sentences.en: His joke was ______ for the formal occasion.
sentences.zh: 他的玩笑對於這個正式場合來說並不恰當。

sentences.en: Wearing sneakers seemed ______ for the wedding.
sentences.zh: 穿運動鞋參加這場婚禮似乎不太恰當。

words.defn_en: incapable of expressing oneself clearly through speech:
words.defn_zh: 口齒不清的/表達不清的

sentences.en: He grew ______ with nervousness during the interview.
sentences.zh: 在面試過程中,他因緊張而變得語無倫次。

sentences.en: Her ______ mumbling made it hard to understand what she wanted.
sentences.zh: 她含糊不清的低語讓人難以理解她想要什麼。

words.defn_en: disabled, made unfit:

sentences.en: The accident left him temporarily ______ and unable to work.
sentences.zh: 這場意外讓他暫時失去行動能力,無法工作。

sentences.en: The injured player was completely ______ for the rest of the season.
sentences.zh: 這名受傷的球員在本季剩餘的時間裡完全無法上場。

words.defn_en: continuing without pause or interruption:

sentences.en: The ______ noise of the construction work made it hard to focus.
sentences.zh: 工地不停歇的噪音讓人難以專心。

sentences.en: Her ______ complaints eventually drove her roommate to move out.
sentences.zh: 她不停的抱怨最終讓她的室友決定搬走。

words.defn_en: unfavorable, stormy:

sentences.en: The flight was delayed due to ______ weather conditions.
sentences.zh: 這班航班因惡劣的天氣狀況而延誤。

sentences.en: Despite the ______ conditions, the hikers continued their journey.
sentences.zh: 儘管天候惡劣,登山客仍繼續他們的旅程。

words.defn_en: disjointed:

sentences.en: After the accident, the driver seemed dazed and gave an ______ statement to police.
sentences.zh: 意外發生後,駕駛顯得神智不清,向警方做出語無倫次的陳述。

sentences.en: His essay was so ______ that the teacher couldn't follow his argument.
sentences.zh: 他的文章語無倫次,老師完全跟不上他的論點。

words.defn_en: without equal; beyond comparison:

sentences.en: The view from the summit was ______ .
sentences.zh: 從山頂望出去的景色無與倫比。

sentences.en: Her ______ talent set her apart from every competitor.
sentences.zh: 她無與倫比的才華讓她從每一位競爭者中脫穎而出。

words.defn_en: quality of being mismatched, lack of harmony:

sentences.en: The couple divorced due to fundamental ______ in their values.
sentences.zh: 這對夫妻因為價值觀根本上的不相容而離婚。

sentences.en: The software update caused ______ issues with older devices.
sentences.zh: 這次軟體更新造成了與舊型裝置不相容的問題。

words.defn_en: not having the necessary skill to do something successfully:
words.root_note: in- (not) + competere (to be suitable), from Latin

sentences.en: The manager was fired for being ______ .
sentences.zh: 這位經理因不稱職而遭到解雇。

sentences.en: Voters called out the ______ handling of the crisis.
sentences.zh: 選民批評了這次危機處理的無能。

words.defn_en: not leading to a clear or definite conclusion; ambiguous:

sentences.en: The results of the experiment were ______, so further testing was needed.
sentences.zh: 這項實驗的結果尚無定論,因此需要進一步的測試。

sentences.en: The investigation remains ______ after months of inquiry.
sentences.zh: 經過數月的調查,這起案件仍然懸而未決。

words.defn_en: poorly organized or crudely put together:
words.defn_zh: 組織不良的;粗製濫造的

sentences.en: The critic dismissed the novel as ______ and unfinished.
sentences.zh: 這位評論家批評這本小說組織不良、尚未完成。

sentences.en: His ______ speech lacked any clear structure.
sentences.zh: 他這篇粗製濫造的演講缺乏任何清晰的架構。

words.defn_en: out of place:

sentences.en: The bright pink door looked ______ against the plain gray building.
sentences.zh: 這扇亮粉色的門和樸素的灰色建築看起來很不協調。

sentences.en: His casual clothing seemed ______ at such a formal event.
sentences.zh: 在如此正式的場合,他休閒的穿著顯得格格不入。

words.defn_en: irrelevant; of no significance; unimportant

sentences.en: The disagreement over lunch plans seemed ______ compared to the bigger issues.
sentences.zh: 與更重大的議題相比,午餐計畫上的分歧顯得無關緊要。

sentences.en: He dismissed the criticism as ______ and moved on with his plan.
sentences.zh: 他把這項批評視為無關緊要,繼續執行自己的計畫。

words.defn_en: not staying the same; contradictory:
words.root_note: in- (not) + consistere (to stand together), from Latin

sentences.en: His story was ______ with what he told police earlier.
sentences.zh: 他的說法與他先前告訴警方的內容不一致。

sentences.en: The team's performance has been ______ this season.
sentences.zh: 這支隊伍本季的表現一直不太穩定一致。

words.defn_en: unable to be comforted; deeply unhappy:
words.defn_zh: 無法安慰的;悲痛欲絕的

sentences.en: She was ______ after losing her mother.
sentences.zh: 失去母親後,她悲痛欲絕、無法安慰。

sentences.en: The child grew ______ once the toy was lost.
sentences.zh: 玩具遺失後,這孩子變得無法安慰。

words.defn_en: hardly noticeable

sentences.en: He tried to remain ______ while sneaking into the meeting late.
sentences.zh: 他試圖悄悄地不引人注意地溜進遲到的會議。

sentences.en: The safe was hidden behind an ______ bookshelf.
sentences.zh: 這個保險箱被藏在一個不起眼的書架後面。

words.defn_en: not able to be disputed; certain:
words.root_note: in- (not) + contestari (to call to witness), from Latin

sentences.en: The evidence against him was ______ .
sentences.zh: 對他不利的證據無可爭辯。

sentences.en: Her achievements in the field are ______ .
sentences.zh: 她在這個領域的成就是無可爭辯的。

words.defn_en: undeniable:
words.defn_zh: 無可辯駁的/不容置疑的

sentences.en: The DNA test provided ______ proof of his innocence.
sentences.zh: DNA檢測提供了無可辯駁的證據,證明他的清白。

sentences.en: The data offers ______ evidence that the climate is changing.
sentences.zh: 這些數據提供了氣候正在變遷的無可辯駁的證據。

words.defn_en: not having a physical body or form:

sentences.en: The ghost story described an ______ presence in the house.
sentences.zh: 這個鬼故事描述了這棟房子裡一股無形的存在。

sentences.en: Philosophers debated whether the soul was ______ .
sentences.zh: 哲學家爭論靈魂是否是非物質的。

words.defn_en: the inability to be reformed or corrected:

sentences.en: The judge cited the offender's ______ when denying parole.
sentences.zh: 這位法官在拒絕假釋時提及了這名罪犯的不可救藥。

sentences.en: His teachers had long given up hope, convinced of his ______ .
sentences.zh: 他的老師們早已放棄希望,認定他無法矯正。

words.defn_en: incapable of correction, delinquent:
words.defn_zh: 無可救藥的/積習難改的

sentences.en: The teacher labeled him an ______ troublemaker after his fifth detention.
sentences.zh: 在他第五次被留校察看後,老師稱他是個無可救藥的問題學生。

sentences.en: Despite years of therapy, his gambling habit proved ______.
sentences.zh: 儘管接受了多年的治療,他的賭博習慣依然無可救藥。

words.defn_en: the quality of being unable to be corrupted or bribed:
words.root_note: in- (not) + corrumpere (to destroy, corrupt), from Latin

sentences.en: The judge's ______ made him widely respected.
sentences.zh: 這位法官的廉潔讓他廣受尊敬。

sentences.en: Voters valued her reputation for ______ .
sentences.zh: 選民重視她廉潔的名聲。

words.defn_en: unable to be corrupted or bribed:
words.root_note: in- (not) + corrumpere (to destroy, corrupt), from Latin

sentences.en: The officer was known to be ______ despite constant temptation.
sentences.zh: 儘管不斷面臨誘惑,這位官員仍以廉潔著稱。

sentences.en: An ______ leader is essential to public trust.
sentences.zh: 一位廉潔的領導者對於贏得大眾信任至關重要。

words.defn_en: impossible or hard to believe; extraordinary:

sentences.en: The rescue was nothing short of ______ .
sentences.zh: 這場救援簡直令人難以置信。

sentences.en: She showed ______ courage during the crisis.
sentences.zh: 她在這場危機中展現出驚人的勇氣。

words.defn_en: skeptical:suspicious

sentences.en: She gave an ______ look when he claimed to have run a marathon in two hours.
sentences.zh: 當他宣稱自己兩小時內跑完馬拉松時,她露出懷疑的表情。

sentences.en: The audience remained ______ despite the magician's convincing trick.
sentences.zh: 儘管魔術師的把戲相當逼真,觀眾仍然半信半疑。

words.defn_en: not able to be cured or healed:

sentences.en: The patient was diagnosed with an ______ but manageable condition.
sentences.zh: 這位病患被診斷出一種無法治癒但可控制的病症。

sentences.en: He remained an ______ optimist despite every setback.
sentences.zh: 儘管歷經每一次挫折,他依然是個無可救藥的樂觀主義者。

words.defn_en: impossible to read, interpret, or understand due to lack of clarity or complexity:
words.defn_zh: 難以辨認的/無法解讀的

sentences.en: The handwriting was so messy it was completely ______.
sentences.zh: 這筆跡潦草到完全無法辨認。

sentences.en: His messy handwriting was ______.
sentences.zh: 他潦草的筆跡讓人完全看不懂。

words.defn_en: incapable of defeat, failure, decay:
words.defn_zh: 不屈不撓的/不知疲倦的

sentences.en: Her ______ efforts finally led to the passage of the new law.
sentences.zh: 她不知疲倦的努力終於促成了這項新法的通過。

sentences.en: The ______ volunteers worked around the clock to help flood victims.
sentences.zh: 這些不屈不撓的志工日夜不停地工作,幫助受洪水影響的災民。

words.defn_en: not able to be forfeited or overturned:
words.defn_zh: 不可剝奪的;不可廢止的
words.root_note: in- (not) + defaire (to undo), from Old French

sentences.en: The constitution guarantees certain ______ rights.
sentences.zh: 這部憲法保障了某些不可剝奪的權利。

sentences.en: He claimed an ______ right to the family inheritance.
sentences.zh: 他聲稱擁有這份家族遺產不可剝奪的權利。

words.defn_en: not precisely determined; vague:
words.root_note: in- (not) + definire (to limit, end), from Latin

sentences.en: The trip was postponed for an ______ period.
sentences.zh: 這趟旅行被無限期延後了。

sentences.en: Her answer remained frustratingly ______ .
sentences.zh: 她的答案仍舊模糊不清,令人感到挫折。

words.defn_en: lacking tact or discretion; crude:

sentences.en: His ______ joke embarrassed everyone at the dinner table.
sentences.zh: 他不得體的笑話讓晚餐桌上的每個人都感到尷尬。

sentences.en: It seemed ______ to ask about her salary so directly.
sentences.zh: 這麼直接詢問她的薪水似乎不太得體。

words.defn_en: too extreme or unusual to be described:

sentences.en: The view from the peak was simply ______ .
sentences.zh: 從山頂望出去的景色實在難以形容。

sentences.en: She felt an ______ sense of relief when the plane landed safely.
sentences.zh: 飛機安全降落時,她感受到一種難以形容的寬慰。

words.defn_en: lack of concern:

sentences.en: His ______ toward the suffering of others shocked everyone.
sentences.zh: 他對他人苦難的漠不關心讓所有人都感到震驚。

sentences.en: She responded to the criticism with total ______.
sentences.zh: 她對這些批評表現出完全的漠不關心。

words.defn_en: apathetic; showing little or no concern or care

sentences.en: He seemed completely ______ to the outcome of the game.
sentences.zh: 他對這場比賽的結果似乎完全漠不關心。

sentences.en: She remained ______ to their pleas for help.
sentences.zh: 面對他們的求助,她依然無動於衷。

words.defn_en: angry

sentences.en: She grew ______ when she was accused of cheating.
sentences.zh: 她被指控作弊時,顯得十分憤慨。

sentences.en: The residents were ______ about the sudden increase in property taxes.
sentences.zh: 居民們對財產稅突然調漲感到十分憤慨。

words.defn_en: anger sparked by something unjust or unfair:

sentences.en: Public ______ grew after the details of the scandal emerged.
sentences.zh: 隨著這起醜聞細節浮出檯面,公眾的憤慨情緒日益高漲。

sentences.en: She could barely contain her ______ at the unfair verdict.
sentences.zh: 面對這項不公的判決,她幾乎無法抑制心中的憤慨。

words.defn_en: not able to be perceived or recognized clearly:

sentences.en: The change in taste was almost ______ to most customers.
sentences.zh: 這種口味的變化對大多數顧客來說幾乎難以察覺。

sentences.en: From this distance, the two buildings are ______ from each other.
sentences.zh: 從這個距離看,這兩棟建築幾乎難以區別。

words.defn_en: choosing at random without careful selection:

sentences.en: The company's ______ hiring policy led it to accept almost anyone who applied.
sentences.zh: 公司不加選擇的招聘政策導致幾乎所有應徵者都會被錄取。

sentences.en: The bombing caused ______ destruction, damaging homes, schools, and hospitals alike.
sentences.zh: 這場轟炸造成了不加選擇的破壞,住家、學校和醫院無一倖免。

words.defn_en: unable to be challenged or denied:

sentences.en: Because the evidence was ______, the lawyer was certain his client would go free.
sentences.zh: 由於證據確鑿無可爭議,律師確信他的當事人將獲得釋放。

sentences.en: Her talent as a violinist is ______.
sentences.zh: 她身為小提琴家的才華是無可爭議的。

words.defn_en: not clear or sharply defined:

sentences.en: The figure in the distance was blurry and ______.
sentences.zh: 遠處的那個身影模糊不清,難以辨認。

sentences.en: Through the thick fog, the outline of the building remained ______.
sentences.zh: 在濃霧之中,這棟建築的輪廓依然模糊不清。

words.defn_en: a state of laziness or avoidance of exertion:
words.root_note: in- (not) + dolere (to suffer, feel pain), from Latin

sentences.en: His ______ frustrated his more ambitious siblings.
sentences.zh: 他的懶散讓他較有野心的手足感到挫折。

sentences.en: Years of ______ left the once-thriving business struggling.
sentences.zh: 多年的怠惰讓這家曾經興盛的企業陷入困境。

words.defn_en: lazy:

sentences.en: The ______ cat spent the entire afternoon napping in the sun.
sentences.zh: 這隻懶洋洋的貓整個下午都在陽光下打盹。

sentences.en: His teachers often complained that he was too ______ to finish his homework.
sentences.zh: 他的老師經常抱怨他太懶散,無法完成作業。

words.defn_en: not capable of being conquered:
words.defn_zh: 不屈不撓的/難以征服的

sentences.en: Her ______ spirit carried her through years of hardship.
sentences.zh: 她不屈不撓的精神支撐她度過了多年的艱難歲月。

sentences.en: The small nation's ______ resistance surprised the invading army.
sentences.zh: 這個小國不屈不撓的抵抗讓入侵的軍隊大感意外。

words.defn_en: impossible to doubt; unquestionable:

sentences.en: Her talent was ______ , even to her harshest critics.
sentences.zh: 即使是她最嚴厲的評論者也不得不承認她的才華無庸置疑。

sentences.en: The evidence provided ______ proof of the theory.
sentences.zh: 這項證據提供了這個理論無庸置疑的證明。

words.defn_en: unspeakable, incapable of being expressed through words:

sentences.en: Watching the sunrise from the mountain top filled her with ______ joy.
sentences.zh: 在山頂看日出讓她感受到難以言喻的喜悅。

sentences.en: The loss left the family with an ______ sadness that words could not capture.
sentences.zh: 這場失去讓這個家庭陷入言語無法表達的哀傷。

words.defn_en: unable to accomplish anything:

sentences.en: The manager's ______ leadership left the team confused and unmotivated.
sentences.zh: 經理無效的領導讓團隊感到困惑且缺乏動力。

sentences.en: All of their ______ attempts to fix the machine only made it worse.
sentences.zh: 他們所有無效的修理嘗試,反而讓機器狀況更糟。
